The background is a quiet, dark space with subtle texture, and the overall design is clean, simple, and respectful. panels.headline: With You In This
panels.body: I am so sorry about your father. I will not try to explain the loss or cover the quiet with easy words; I am here beside you, at whatever pace the day allows.
